content.title: Data Table (Page 1)
headers: Chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) is characterized by the presence of the Philadelphia chromosome, the product of t(9;22)(q34;q11) translocation. This translocation results in BCR-ABL1 fusion protein with constitutive ABL1 tyrosine kinase activity. The kinase inhibitor imatinib (STI571, Gleevec®) inhibits ABL1 kinase activity and is now the standard of care for early phase CML. Prolonged treatment with imatinib can lead to drug resistance, especially in patients with advanced disease. A large portion of resistant patients have acquired point mutations in the ABL1 kinase domain that renders the kinase resistant to the drug. Sites of point mutations in ABL1 associated with imatinib resistance span the entire kinase domain but often cluster in important hotspots.(1,2) Total RNA was extracted and nested reverse transcription PCR was performed to detect the BCR-ABL1 transcript and ABL1 kinase domain (KD) region was thereafter sequenced by Next Generation Sequencing for detection of mutant alleles.

headers: Chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) is characterized by the presence of the Philadelphia chromosome, the product of t(9;22)(q34;q11) translocation. This translocation results in BCR-ABL1 fusion protein with constitutive ABL1 tyrosine kinase activity. The kinase inhibitor imatinib (STI571, Gleevec®) inhibits ABL1 kinase activity and is now the standard of care for early phase CML. Prolonged treatment with imatinib can lead to drug resistance, especially in patients with advanced disease. A large portion of resistant patients have acquired point mutations in the ABL1 kinase domain that renders the kinase resistant to the drug. Sites of point mutations in ABL1 associated with imatinib resistance span the entire kinase domain but often cluster in important hotspots.(1,2) Total RNA was extracted and nested reverse transcription PCR was performed to detect the BCR-ABL1 transcript and ABL1 kinase domain (KD) region was thereafter sequenced by Next Generation Sequencing for detection of mutant alleles.
